summary: Evidence v2 now has explicit schemas, examples, provider-neutral Python records, a registry inspect surface, status events, and a legacy AWKP evidence-manifest adapter.

design_points.result: Evidence records bind claimRefs, gateRef, gateDefinitionDigest, gateRunId, result, confidence, subject digests, dependency digests, runtime/policy/verifier/test/environment digests, validity state, TTL, refs, and supersedes.
GateRun records now bind gateDefinitionDigest, subject/dependency digest refs, environment digests, validity state, stored fingerprint, command, timing, result, and evidenceRef.
EvidenceStatusEvent records state transitions separately from immutable Evidence payloads and can name supersededBy without overwriting historical evidence.
EvidenceRegistryPort was added to src/ahra/ports.py for put, inspect, status-event append, and legacy-manifest adaptation without depending on provider SDKs.

compatibility_notes: Existing EvidenceGate v1 task-completion reports remain unchanged and readable.
Evidence v2 is added as new contracts and Python records; no Evidence v1 payloads are deleted or silently upgraded.
Legacy AWKP evidence manifests are labeled legacy_partial by the adapter because they do not contain full v2 fingerprint bindings.
